text.p: Average yields at auctions of six-, nine- and 18-month treasury bills were unchanged and 12-month yields slipped from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Thursday.

Six-month bills were unchanged at 20.20 percent, nine-month bills were unchanged at 28.18 percent, 12-month bills slipped to 30.36 percent from 30.38 percent, and 18-month bills were unchanged at 32.56 percent.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 22.50 million UAH 22.50 million UAH
Amount sold 19.01 million UAH 8.02 million UAH
Actual amount raised 17.27 million UAH 7.28 million UAH
The central bank sold 190,100 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 4.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 20.00 million UAH no limit stated
Amount sold 20.00 million UAH 3.10 million UAH
Actual amount raised 16.52 million UAH 2.56 million UAH
The central bank sold 200,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 4.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated 59.50 million UAH
Amount sold 86.75 million UAH 52.82 million UAH
Actual amount raised 66.59 million UAH 40.54 million UAH
The central bank sold 867,489 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 4.
The results of the 18-month T-bill auction were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 24.34 million UAH 9.68 million UAH
Actual amount raised 16.37 million UAH 6.51 million UAH
The central bank sold 243,420 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of discount 18-month T-bills was not fixed.
